mobbin:b7d28210-31a2-48c6-92fc-604379301.summary: A new merchant lands on Home, checks empty Alerts and the account menu, and advances the setup guide. They reach a live Home with headline numbers, Things to do next, and a completed guide that can be dismissed.
steps: Home setup guide at 0/11 with a trial message
Alerts panel when there are no alerts
Headline-number strip, Things to do, and sales guide
Orders-to-fulfill card and dual progress guides
Setup guide Done with Dismiss and discovery
steal: An accordion setup guide shows an N of M progress bar and one expanded task that owns the main and secondary buttons (Add product / Import).
Alerts empty copy ('Alerts about your store...') still shows a mark-all-read control even when empty (screen 2).
A precise ops card ('2 orders to fulfill') sits above longer guides as one countable next action, not a widget wall.
Once marked Done, an explicit 'Dismiss guide' appears, then an 'All caught up' divider before discovery cards (screen 7).
avoid: Screens 6-7 stack promotional cards (Shopify Magic, Discover more) under the guide, which clashes with show little, but precisely.
mobbin:b7d28210-31a2-48c6-92fc-604379301.fit: Dashboard: a center first-run checklist (rooms, cameras, users) on the home, handing off into Inventory, User management, or Scenario manager, with countable ops before Reports headline numbers.

mobbin:2513bddc-2b15-4e3e-8ba3-39b637ccc.summary: From the Home setup guide the merchant opens Add product, inserts a sample product, marks the step done, and watches the right-rail guide advance while staying on the product editor.
steps: Home setup guide at 1/11 with Add first product expanded
Add product form with persistent setup rail
Sample product saved with success banner
Mark as done on the checklist item
Guide at 2/11 with next digital-products task
Guide at 3/11 with online-store sharing details
steal: The setup guide stays as a right rail while the user does the real work in the module, not as a blocking step-by-step tour.
An 'Add a sample product' shortcut unblocks first-run without full data entry (screen 2).
A green 'Sample product added' banner offers Preview and dismiss (screen 3).
A manual 'Mark as done' covers cases when auto-detect is incomplete (screens 3-4).
avoid: The flow is tagged action-items, but the screens show setup-checklist progress only, with no inbox dismiss, snooze, or done on operational tasks.
mobbin:2513bddc-2b15-4e3e-8ba3-39b637ccc.fit: Dashboard: extends first-run by keeping the checklist visible while the admin completes the task inside Inventory, Scenario manager, or User management. It is not a substitute for the action-items inbox.
